verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents automated pull request reviews that give contextual feedback and suggestions, which covers catching problems before merge. A community report says its code review caught multiple potential bugs. The evidence does not show explicit diff inspection or running checks such as tests and linters, so only part of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: documented diff viewing/inspection, a documented way to run tests/lint/CI checks before merging, deeper first-party docs on the review workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Pull Request Reviews: Automated code review with contextual feedback and suggestions
It has officially caught multiple potential bugs, even a few that reviewers might have missed.
